chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, who said:
I asked him about the time of ẓuhr and al-ʿaṣr, so he wrote: one qāmah for ẓuhr and one qāmah for al-ʿaṣr.

key_terms.قَامَةً: a measured length used here as a standard for prayer timing
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time or timing of an act of worship

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in al-Istibṣār say about the time of ẓuhr and al-ʿaṣr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the timing of the ẓuhr and al-ʿaṣr prayers. It states a measured standard for each prayer time, indicating a jurisprudential basis for determining their proper time.
